algos.dinov2-linear-head: $\hat y = \arg\max_k (W (z - \mu) / \sigma + b)_k$ with $z$ the frozen DINOv2 embedding of the photo and $(W, b)$ fit by class-weighted logistic regression
algos.llm-diagnosis: answer = Claude(photos of the post, its title and text, optionally the classifier's probabilities per photo), graded against the advice that worked in the thread

params.setting: which datasets the head is trained on: indoor (Indoor Plant Disease only) or all (Indoor, Wilted, PlantSeg, PlantDoc)
params.embedding: $z = [h_0 ; \frac{1}{256} \sum_p h_p]$: CLS token and mean patch token of the last layer
params.n_train: $n$: number of training images after cleaning
params.n_val: number of validation images after cleaning
params.sources: datasets the training images come from
params.C_grid: values of $C$ tried; the one with the best validation balanced accuracy is kept
params.C: $C$: inverse regularization strength in $C \sum_i w_{y_i} \ell_i + \frac{1}{2} \lVert W \rVert_F^2$
params.class_weight: $w_k = n / (K n_k)$: each label weighs the same in the loss
params.val_frac: share of each (source, label) group held out for validation
params.dup_threshold: $\tau$: two images are duplicates if $\cos(h_0^{(i)}, h_0^{(j)}) \geq \tau$ (or identical files)
params.image_size: $s$: the photo's shorter side is resized to $\lfloor 256 s / 224 \rfloor$, then center-cropped to $s \times s$ pixels, giving $(s / 14)^2$ patch tokens
params.model: Claude model that answers the post
params.grader: Claude model that grades each answer against the thread's confirmed problem, advice and outcome, without knowing the option
params.option: llm: post only; llm+classifier: post plus the classifier's probabilities for each photo and a warning that it is unreliable
params.classifier: trained head whose output is added in option llm+classifier
params.n_threads: number of resolved Reddit threads evaluated
params.prompt: system prompt of the answering model: plain (none), guided, guided-v2 (diagnose.py SYSTEM_PROMPTS: how to tell causes apart, one main cause first, then the fix), or guided-v2+<elements> (diagnose.py ELEMENTS: kb = generic plant-care notes, priors = common causes ranked, question = answer the question asked, differential = weigh 3 causes first, format = short fixed answer format, limits = answer rules from eval_methodology.md: at most 4 actions, each under 15 min/day and at most $15, no backup options, no treatment for a healthy plant, no unsafe advice)
params.threads: which resolved threads are scored: all 96, dev (32 used to write the prompts) or test (the other 64, held out; split with seed 0)
params.search: whether the answering model may run up to 3 web searches before answering (server-side web_search tool); reddit.com, its image hosts and Reddit mirrors/archives are blocked, so it cannot find the thread itself; 'research': up to 5 searches, told to identify the plant, look up its needs and every cause that could fit, and how each is cured
params.samples: answers per thread and option; each is graded, and scores are averaged per thread before averaging over threads
params.effort: effort setting of the answering model (low, medium, high, max): how much it thinks before answering

symbols.h_0: CLS token of DINOv2's last layer
symbols.y: pooled label: healthy, watering, fungal_bacterial, pest, other
symbols.W, b: weights and bias of the linear head, $W \in \mathbb{R}^{K \times 1536}$
symbols.\\mu, \\sigma: per-coordinate mean and standard deviation of $z$ on the training images
symbols.n_k: number of training images with label $k$
symbols.p(y \\mid x_j): the classifier's softmax probability of label $y$ for photo $x_j$
